tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Who Jan Linketscher is: managing director and shareholder of the digital agency i22 (Bonn), his background, how his texts are written, and how to contact him. Content is in German.

tools.name: list_essays
tools.description: List the essays, newest first: title, date, one-sentence summary, topics, URL and slug. Optionally filter by topic slug. Also returns the available topics.

tools.name: get_essay
tools.description: Full text of one essay as Markdown (with front matter). Use the slug from list_essays or search.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Full-text search across all essays and pages (about, context). Returns the best matches with title, URL and a short snippet. German queries work best.

tools.name: list_meeting_types
tools.description: The kinds of calls that can be booked with Jan Linketscher ("kennenlernen" (Kennenlernen, 30 min), "sparring" (Sparring, 60 min)), with duration, purpose and a booking link for humans.

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Free time slots for a call with Jan Linketscher. meeting_type: "kennenlernen" (Kennenlernen, 30 min), "sparring" (Sparring, 60 min). Optional date range (YYYY-MM-DD, default: the next 14 days, at most 90 days ahead). Times are ISO 8601 with offset; the text answer lists them in Europe/Berlin.

tools.name: book_meeting
tools.description: Book a call with Jan Linketscher on behalf of your user. The start must be a slot returned by get_availability. If your client supports elicitation (form mode, MCP 2026-07-28), the server itself asks the user to confirm time, name and email – name and email are then prefilled from your arguments and

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_essays, search, book_meeting · Private data: get_profile · Public sink: book_meeting.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_essays, search, book_meeting · Private data: get_profile · Public sink: book_meeting

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
